items.title: TNT Run
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Enjoy life with a bang in really dynamite skins! Choose from lots of colorful options. It’s sure to be a blast when you role-play in dangerously explosive gear. Run, don’t walk and light your fuse to burst out and have a good time.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Teen Impostors!
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Will the impostors survive? Become a terrific teen and find out. Gear up in one of 12 different stylish space suit skins. Role-play your part in a real puzzle, and see who lasts longest. Be careful and be smart. Don’t let the space crew catch you!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cyber Vibe
items.creator: Owls Cubed
items.description: Ten street-tech looks wired with acid-green neon, from visored masks and hooded jackets to lab coats and tactical cargo pants. Everything sits on a dark graphite palette so the glowing trim really pops, and every character gets its own face, hair and attitude. Ten original slim-model skins, ready to plug in.

items.title: Animatronic Pets HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
When the lights are out, the pets will play. Roleplay as a spooky animatronic animal meant for fun stage entertainment! Dogs, cats, lizards, ferrets, birds etc included.

+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Crazy Mobs
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Minecraft mobs have invaded the city! They transformed cool teens and now your world is overrun by Pigmens, slimes, Creepers, and even Endermen! Free the city from these 'Crazy Mobs' and revert the teens to their cute style!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 mob-themed skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Toxic Tides
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Alert, calling all emergency responders! The Aspia nuclear plant has suffered a major meltdown, and the government needs YOU to help clear the island. Search for keycards to unlock a hazmat suit and descend into radioactive zones to recover loot!

- Radioactive zones
- Toxic acid
- Radioactive mobs
- 4 new skins
- Licensed by LeadPro and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Anime Fighters
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Choose your Anime Fighter and fight the creatures around! Get ready for the battle with 11 unique Anime Fighters skins!

- 10 epic anime fighters skins!
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Glitch Mobs
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These glitch mobs enter your consoles, computers and phones! Don't worry they are harmless viruses and just like to have a bit of fun while playing pranks. Join these glitch mobs on their mission to have the most fun of their lives! Become a cool glitch mob today!

- 10 glitch mob skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Mob Mermaids
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Mermaids are cool, beautiful and magical! These mermaids live in an underwater fantasy world. Mermaids are full of wonder and magic so become a mermaid today!

- 11 mob mermaids
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Nether Creatures Emerge
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
With this skin pack you can become one of the many creepy monsters found in the Nether! Choose from one of these 12 fire hot skins and get ready to explore! The Nether is a dark and scary place. You will need to fit right in with the other Nether horrors that lurk near the lava.

- 12 Nether creature skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Super Cute Mobs
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description:
Play Minecraft like never before! Enjoy 60 ultra-adorable skins that will let you become the cutest mob in the entire world. This epic skin pack is not only the most adorable but also the first one to include almost all of our loved mobs.

- Includes 60 mob skins!
- Detailed HD skins in 128px

items.title: City Street Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Being a unique modern teen has never been so easy! Show off your high end luxury city looks while living your dream life. Are you ready to be free of a basic closet? If so, this pack is for you!

- 16 trendy skins

items.title: Golem Guard
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Big Dye Gaming presents: Golem Guard! Need sweaty hands? Need exciting action? Be the first to master a new minigame.

- Featuring A.I. supported combat. Never the same game!
- Play alone or with friends against A.I. 
- PVP combat; use any combination per team.
- Custom world
- Licensed by Big Dye Gaming and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Manga Tone
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Kyaaa! Unleash your inner manga-lover. Play as classic manga characters included in this pack, from kawaii school girls to tsundere handsome guys.

- Contains 10 skins for boys and girls
- Inspired by manga
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from PSB.

items.title: Lovely Animals
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Show your lovely side with these colorful skins. This skin pack is based on fluffy animals with extra cute heart-shaped patterns on their fur.

- Contains 12 colorful animal-themed skins.
- Even a unicorn skin!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from PSB.

items.title: Dream Jobs
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Pursue your dream job and be the best at it! Start your career right away and live your dream job with your friends!

- 6 dream jobs, perfect for all kinds of people!
- Choose your side and let the adventure begin!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Meraki Studios.

items.title: Martial Arts Munchies
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Your favorite foods are now ready to kick some butt! Dressed in cool karate outfits, these snacks are looking fabulous and deadly. Pick your favorite food and team up with your friends!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Unique theme!
+ Collect all martial arts and snack skin packs!

items.title: Working Folk 2
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to be a firefighter? What about a nurse? Dress up for your dream job! Choose from six different careers! Everyone can find a skin to wear with these working outfits!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Dress for success!
+ Collect all job-themed skin packs!

items.title: Valley of the Dragon
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Explore the pagodas of this gorgeous Asian-inspired spawn! Discover the dungeons underground and trade with the local villagers. With colors that pop and hours of exploring, this spawn is perfect for any Minecraft player.

+ Colorful and detailed Asian-inspired build theme
+ Hours of exploration, above and below ground
+ Villagers to trade with!
+ Custom textures included!

items.title: Ender Mobs
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
The Ender infection has come to the overworld! Mobs of all kinds are now among us using dark powers! Are you lucky enough to block their attacks or will you join their forces as a member of the Ender legion?

- Includes four Ender empowered mob skins and a super powered Enderman skin!

items.title: Talented Magic Fairy
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Get up close and marvel at these creative and fun fairies that show you a magical and diverse world. You will find variety in the talents that each one has to show the world!

-Fourteen beautiful fairy skins.
-Two skins totally free.
-Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Cyberpunk Fashion
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
In a bright and technological world you must be ready to wear bright colors and techno clothes to prepare for the future; get fashionable!

-Twelve skins.
-One skin totally free.
-Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Legendary Ninjas
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
It has been foretold for thousands of years that someday these legendary ninjas would appear, now the time has arrived. Become a ninja with one of these amazing outfits!

-Ten amazing ninja skins.
-One skin totally free.
-Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Famous Youngsters
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Live your best life in fame! Walk downtown in luxury and show the world your inner glow! Go shopping and discover the life of a famous millionaire. You can enjoy your free time after a busy day in the city and discover the benefits of being famous and rich! Don't miss this chance of a life time!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 teen skins
+ By Team Visionary
